title: Answer: the universe, and local subjects within it

statements.text: The universe is conscious, and so are humans and other animals as local subjects. Goff assumes not every macro-level system is a subject and leaves which ones to an empirical theory. On Shani and Keppler’s version every quantum system is conscious, from atoms rudimentarily to coherent cell assemblies, and classical systems are not.
